name: omlx-connector
description: Delegate text work to a local model on oMLX — content never leaves your machine
long_description: Lets Claude and other MCP clients hand off text work to a model running locally via oMLX, so material that must not be sent to a cloud API — recordings and transcripts of other people, unpublished research, client or student records — can still be summarized, rewritten, and classified. The server refuses non-loopback hosts unless explicitly permitted, so the privacy property is enforced in code rather than promised in documentation. Requires macOS on Apple silicon and a running oMLX server.

tools.name: local_summarize
tools.description: Summarize text on a local model, with a sentence budget and optional focus

tools.name: local_rewrite
tools.description: Rewrite text per an instruction on a local model — ASR cleanup, tone, formatting

tools.name: local_classify
tools.description: Assign text to one of a set of categories using a local model

tools.name: local_complete
tools.description: Send an arbitrary prompt to a local model; reasoning optional

tools.name: local_models
tools.description: List available local models, their context windows, and which are loaded
